lines.zh: 我摆着长身游过珊瑚塔。
lines.en: I sweep my long body past the coral towers.

lines.zh: 鳃边的褶一动一动，我压着水走。
lines.en: The frills by my gills ripple as I press through the water.

lines.zh: 我贴着沟底的沙游，很慢。
lines.en: I cruise low over the trench floor, slowly.

lines.zh: 身太长，我拐弯要绕一大圈。
lines.en: My body is so long that turning takes a wide loop.

lines.zh: 我在深水的暗处穿过去。
lines.en: I pass through the dark of the deep water.

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，我带起一股浑水。
lines.en: One sweep of my tail stirs up cloudy water.

lines.zh: 我沿着沟壁向上，像一条蛇。
lines.en: I climb the trench wall like a snake.

lines.zh: 我游得不快，但一直不停。
lines.en: I do not swim fast, but I never stop.

lines.zh: 冷水从我鳃缝里挤出去。
lines.en: Cold water squeezes out through my gill slits.

lines.zh: 我从珊瑚丛上方滑过，影子很长。
lines.en: I slide over the coral, casting a long shadow.

lines.zh: 我扭了一下身体，钻进窄缝里。
lines.en: I twist my body and slip into a narrow gap.

lines.zh: 我的腹鳍蹭过沙，留下浅痕。
lines.en: My pelvic fins brush the sand and leave faint marks.

lines.zh: 我绕着一块礁石转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle a reef rock halfway around.

lines.zh: 我朝更深的地方缓缓沉下去。
lines.en: I sink slowly toward deeper ground.

lines.zh: 我把身体折成一道弯，才转过礁角。
lines.en: I fold my body into a bend just to round the reef corner.

lines.zh: 鳃边的褶张开，我把水滤一遍。
lines.en: The frills by my gills open, and I sift the water through.

lines.zh: 沟底的冷流推着我的尾。
lines.en: The cold current along the trench floor pushes my tail.

lines.zh: 我仰起头，朝上方那点光游。
lines.en: I tilt up and swim toward that one patch of light.

lines.zh: 我悬在沟里，尾巴慢慢摆。
lines.en: I hang in the trench, tail swaying slowly.

lines.zh: 褶鳃张合，我在等水流过。
lines.en: My frilled gills open and close as I wait for water.

lines.zh: 深处没有光，我照样看得清。
lines.en: There is no light down here, yet I see clearly.

lines.zh: 有一条章鱼的味道，我没动。
lines.en: There is a trace of octopus, and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我把头对着沟口，静静等。
lines.en: I face the trench mouth and wait quietly.

lines.zh: 身边的小鱼离我很远。
lines.en: The little fish around me keep their distance.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了试水，又闭上。
lines.en: I open my mouth to taste the water and close it.

lines.zh: 沙在沟底慢慢滑，我听着。
lines.en: Sand creeps along the trench floor and I listen.

lines.zh: 我盘起身子，像一圈旧绳。
lines.en: I coil my body like a loop of old rope.

lines.zh: 冷水贴着我的背，很舒服。
lines.en: Cold water runs along my back and it feels good.

lines.zh: 我抬头看水面，那光太远了。
lines.en: I look up at the surface; the light is far away.

lines.zh: 我慢吞吞地换了个位置。
lines.en: I shift position, slow as ever.

lines.zh: 礁石缝里有动静，我等着。
lines.en: Something stirs in the rock crevice and I wait.

lines.zh: 我呼吸很慢，几乎听不见。
lines.en: My breathing is slow and nearly silent.

lines.zh: 我在暗处看着你下沉。
lines.en: From the dark I watch you descend.

lines.zh: 你的灯照过来，我的眼睛发亮。
lines.en: Your lamp sweeps over and my eyes shine.

lines.zh: 我在你上方转了个半圈。
lines.en: I turn half a circle above you.

lines.zh: 鳃褶张开，我悬在你上方。
lines.en: My gill frills flare as I hang above you.

lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚看你，鳃褶张开。
lines.en: I watch you from the coral with my gill frills spread.

lines.zh: 你在沟边停住，我慢慢靠近。
lines.en: You stop at the trench edge and I drift closer.

lines.zh: 我把头抬高，正对你的方向。
lines.en: I raise my head to face you squarely.

lines.zh: 你的气泡往上跑，我一直看。
lines.en: Your bubbles race upward and I keep watching.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，又游回来。
lines.en: I slip behind you, then swim back around.

lines.zh: 我在暗水里跟你对着眼。
lines.en: In the dark water I hold your gaze.

lines.zh: 侧腹被撕开，血在身后拖成长线。
lines.en: My flank is torn open and blood trails behind me.

lines.zh: 我疼得弓起身，鳃褶全缩了。
lines.en: Pain arches my body and my gill frills retract.

lines.zh: 这一击让我撞在礁石上。
lines.en: The blow slams me into the reef.

lines.zh: 身上的伤在冷水里发烫。
lines.en: My wound burns even in the cold water.

lines.zh: 我转过来，先把牙露出来。
lines.en: I turn around and bare my teeth first.

lines.zh: 挨了这一下，我更想咬回去。
lines.en: After that hit I want to bite back even more.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴不太听使唤了。
lines.en: My tail no longer quite obeys me.

lines.zh: 血味是自己的，我认得。
lines.en: The blood is mine, and I know it.

lines.zh: 深沟里我先绕一圈。
lines.en: I'll circle once in the deep trench.

lines.zh: 伤口裂着，我游得越来越慢。
lines.en: The wound gapes and I swim slower and slower.

lines.zh: 血味散开，我的鳃褶全张了。
lines.en: Blood spreads and my gill frills flare wide.

lines.zh: 你把鱼块放下，我慢慢游近。
lines.en: You set down a fish chunk and I glide nearer.

lines.zh: 那条章鱼在动，我忍不住。
lines.en: That octopus is moving and I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 味道太浓，我沿着它游过去。
lines.en: The scent is strong, so I follow it over.

lines.zh: 我围着那团东西转了两圈。
lines.en: I circle that morsel twice.

lines.zh: 你手一收，我跟着冲了一下。
lines.en: You pull your hand back and I lunge a little.

lines.zh: 饿意上来，我把谨慎丢开了。
lines.en: Hunger rises and I cast caution aside.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，又没敢咬。
lines.en: I open my mouth, then do not dare to bite.

lines.zh: 水里的血丝把我引得很近。
lines.en: Threads of blood draw me very close.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的东西不眨眼。
lines.en: I stare at what is in your hand without blinking.

lines.zh: 被撞了一下，我的长身扭开了。
lines.en: Something rams me and my long body twists aside.

lines.zh: 同伴的尾巴扫过我侧腹。
lines.en: A companion's tail swipes across my flank.

lines.zh: 我撞上珊瑚，褶鳃立刻合紧。
lines.en: I hit the coral and my frilled gills clamp shut.

lines.zh: 你推我一把，我整条都退了。
lines.en: You push me and my whole length recoils.

lines.zh: 大鱼撞过来，我只好让开。
lines.en: A big fish charges and I have to give way.

lines.zh: 我卡在两块礁之间，挣了一下。
lines.en: I wedge between two rocks and wrench myself free.

lines.zh: 我撞开一只章鱼，它喷了墨。
lines.en: I knock an octopus aside and it squirts ink.

lines.zh: 水流把我挤向沟壁，我侧身贴住。
lines.en: The current pins me to the wall and I go side-on.

lines.zh: 谁的鳍顶了我一下，我转头。
lines.en: A fin jabs me and I twist my head around.

lines.zh: 我被撞得翻了个身，才正过来。
lines.en: I am knocked into a roll before righting myself.

lines.zh: 我绕着她游，身体贴得很近。
lines.en: I circle her, keeping my body close.

lines.zh: 我们并着身，慢慢沉下去。
lines.en: Bodies side by side, we sink slowly.

lines.zh: 我用吻碰了碰她的鳃褶。
lines.en: I touch her gill frills with my snout.

lines.zh: 她把尾巴搭在我身上。
lines.en: She lays her tail across me.

lines.zh: 两条长影在沟底缠了一会儿。
lines.en: Two long shadows twine along the trench floor.

lines.zh: 我游在前面，她跟着。
lines.en: I swim ahead and she follows.

lines.zh: 我们停在暗处，谁也没动。
lines.en: We stop in the dark and neither of us stirs.

lines.zh: 她转过来，我让开一道水。
lines.en: She turns and I yield a lane of water.

lines.zh: 暖流来了，我们一起往上走。
lines.en: A warm current comes and we rise together.

lines.zh: 这片沟底安静，适合待着。
lines.en: This stretch of trench is quiet, a good place to stay.

lines.zh: 我咬住那块肉，又放下。
lines.en: I take the meat in my teeth and set it down.

lines.zh: 牙齿弯，我叼不稳东西。
lines.en: My teeth are hooked and I cannot grip things well.

lines.zh: 我试着拖动它，沙全扬起来。
lines.en: I try to drag it and sand billows up.

lines.zh: 整只章鱼太大，我撕了一半。
lines.en: The octopus is too big, so I tear off half.

lines.zh: 我把它压在礁石下面藏好。
lines.en: I press it under a rock to hide it.

lines.zh: 嘴里含着，我的鳃都合不严。
lines.en: With it in my mouth, my gills cannot close properly.

lines.zh: 我用吻顶它，一点点往前推。
lines.en: I push it with my snout, a little at a time.

lines.zh: 东西滑出去，我追了两米。
lines.en: It slides away and I chase it two meters.

lines.zh: 我咬得太用力，把它咬断了。
lines.en: I bite too hard and snap it in two.

lines.zh: 我把它拖进暗处再慢慢吃。
lines.en: I drag it into the dark and eat at leisure.

lines.zh: 一条小鱼游近，我的头转过去。
lines.en: A small fish comes near and my head swings toward it.

lines.zh: 我闻到章鱼的味，锁定了。
lines.en: I smell octopus and lock on.

lines.zh: 小鲨鱼在远处，我朝它游。
lines.en: A small shark is far off and I swim toward it.

lines.zh: 一只走错路的小生物，我盯上。
lines.en: A small creature has strayed, and I mark it.

lines.zh: 我听见挣扎的声音，方向定了。
lines.en: I hear struggling and my heading is set.

lines.zh: 它没看见我，我已经对准了。
lines.en: It has not seen me, and I am already aimed.

lines.zh: 大鲨鱼的影子一来，我改主意。
lines.en: A big shark's shadow arrives and I change my mind.

lines.zh: 我选了最慢的那一只。
lines.en: I pick the slowest one.

lines.zh: 我把身体扳向那股血味。
lines.en: I swing my body toward that scent of blood.

lines.zh: 目标一确定，我就不再犹豫。
lines.en: Once the target is set, I do not hesitate.

lines.zh: 我贴着沟底逼近，几乎无声。
lines.en: I close in along the trench floor, almost silent.

lines.zh: 我绕到它背风的一侧。
lines.en: I work around to its lee side.

lines.zh: 它转身，我便停住下沉。
lines.en: It turns, and I stop my descent.

lines.zh: 我一点一点收短距离。
lines.en: I shorten the distance bit by bit.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落到它身上。
lines.en: My shadow reaches it before I do.

lines.zh: 它慌了，我等着它犯错。
lines.en: It panics, and I wait for a mistake.

lines.zh: 我把嘴张开一点，又合上。
lines.en: I part my jaws slightly, then close them.

lines.zh: 我数着它的动作，找破口。
lines.en: I count its movements, looking for an opening.

lines.zh: 珊瑚挡住了我，我换了个角度。
lines.en: Coral blocks me, so I shift my angle.

lines.zh: 再近半米，我就扑过去。
lines.en: Half a meter closer and I will strike.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，牙齿全弯进肉里。
lines.en: I bite down and my hooked teeth sink into flesh.

lines.zh: 长身一绞，我把它缠住了。
lines.en: One coil of my long body pins it fast.

lines.zh: 我甩头撕下一块，水立刻浑了。
lines.en: I shake my head and tear a piece free; the water clouds.

lines.zh: 它挣，我的牙咬得更死。
lines.en: It struggles and my teeth clamp harder.

lines.zh: 我从下往上撞，把它顶翻。
lines.en: I strike from below and flip it over.

lines.zh: 这一口咬偏，我立刻补上一下。
lines.en: That bite misses, so I snap again at once.

lines.zh: 我把它拖向沟底压住。
lines.en: I drag it to the trench floor and pin it down.

lines.zh: 尾巴抽过去，它被拍向礁石。
lines.en: My tail lashes and sends it into the rock.

lines.zh: 它咬回来，我也没松口。
lines.en: It bites back, and I still do not let go.

lines.zh: 血流出来，我才慢慢放开。
lines.en: Only when the blood flows do I slowly release.

lines.zh: 我从深沟的暗处浮上来。
lines.en: I rise out of the dark of the deep trench.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁下多了一条长影，是我。
lines.en: A long shadow appears under the reef, and it is me.

lines.zh: 冷水一转，我就在这儿了。
lines.en: The cold water swirls and here I am.

lines.zh: 沟壁上没有别人，只有我。
lines.en: There is no one on the wall but me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾，试了试周围的水。
lines.en: I sway my tail and test the surrounding water.

lines.zh: 这处海沟够深，我留下。
lines.en: This trench is deep enough, so I stay.

lines.zh: 我从暗处露出头，褶鳃张开。
lines.en: I show my head from the dark, gill frills spread.

lines.zh: 一片幽蓝里，我独自游着。
lines.en: In the deep blue I swim alone.

lines.zh: 我绕着新地方转了一圈。
lines.en: I make one circuit of this new place.

lines.zh: 深处安静，我先躲进礁缝。
lines.en: The deep is quiet, so I slip into a reef crevice.

lines.zh: 水被烧热，我的鳃褶缩成一团。
lines.en: The water burns hot and my gill frills curl tight.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下，长身撞在石上。
lines.en: I drop from above and my long body hits stone.

lines.zh: 离开水，我的褶鳃贴在头上。
lines.en: Out of water, my frilled gills flatten against my head.

lines.zh: 爆响把水撕开，我翻着滚出去。
lines.en: The blast tears the water and I tumble away.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎进我背上。
lines.en: Something sharp buries itself in my back.

lines.zh: 怪力钻进骨头，我僵了一瞬。
lines.en: Strange force seeps into my bones and I lock up.

lines.zh: 太久没吃，我的牙都软了。
lines.en: I have not eaten so long my teeth feel soft.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我浑身一抽。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and my whole body jerks.

lines.zh: 水没了，我的身体在虚空里挣。
lines.en: The water is gone and my body thrashes in the void.
